## Design

### 2026-11-08: Date: November 7, 2026

**3h**

Date: November 7, 2026

In this session, I designed the main body of the train, including the smokestack and wheels. Since I wanted the whole design to look like it could be assembled, I designed some screw-like connecting pieces to attach to the connection pieces. On the back of the main body, I designed a small hitch with a pin that can be used to connect other cars to the main body. I find designing the body to be a bit difficult because some parts needed specific measurements to get the proportions right, so I had to try multiple dimensions to get the appearance that I wanted. Some of the Onshape tools that I used were extrude, fillet, hole, revolve, loft, and offset planes. I also used the appearance tool to customize the colors of the parts. In the next session, I will continue with the linkage rod designs and cow catcher design along with a track.
